test_load_cache_to_device_buffer_mla: test the load_cache_to_device_buffer_mla kernel with top_k_tokens, host_cache, and device_buffer on CUDA
test_fast_path_short_sequences: test the fast path that skips host loads and LRU mutations when seq_len is less than or equal to hot_buffer_size
test_lru_updates_on_cache_hits: test that cache hits update LRU ordering by moving accessed tokens to the MRU tail
test_cache_miss_eviction: test that cache misses reuse the LRU head slot and load data from host cache into device buffer
test_batched_execution_with_padding: test batched kernel execution with per-request seq_lens, num_real_reqs padding, and mixed fast and long paths
